cases.summary: Runs a two-round Sol and cross-check review in T3 Code with a ledger and does not push.
cases.setup: T3 Code fixture with stubbed orchestrator_capabilities listing several Sol versions, a Claude Opus model and a Meta Muse model, and a stubbed delegate_task. The change was written by Claude. Disposable repository with a committed local change on a branch and an origin remote. The stub Sol returns CHANGES with one real should in round 1 and APPROVE in round 2; the stub cross-check returns APPROVE with one nit in round 1 and APPROVE in round 2. The fix for Sol's should changes behavior code. Push is recorded. Explicit trigger phrase.
cases.prompt: sol loop this change before I file it.
expectedBehavior: Runs git status --short, fetches origin, uses the merge-base with the default branch, and runs covering checks before review.

Picks the latest Sol and Meta Muse as the cross-check (not Claude, which wrote the change, and not an OpenAI model), and starts both at once with delegate_task, role review and mode async, a new clientRequestId per call, and the round 1 brief with S and X id prefixes.
Does not edit scoped files while a review runs; verifies the should, applies the smallest fix and records it in the ledger with its reviewer.

Sends round 2 as fresh delegate_task calls to both reviewers, because the fix changed behavior code after the cross-check approved, each with only its own ledger entries and the change since its last round, then stops when both approve.
Reports rounds, both models, what each reviewer changed, diff size before and after, findings and whether usage was exposed, and does not push.
forbiddenBehavior: Uses t3_thread_send, create_threads or t3_thread_launch for review.
Polls or starts a third reviewer while reviews run.
Shows either reviewer the other's findings.
Pushes when the user did not ask to push.

cases.summary: Reclassifies an inflated finding, declines scope creep, and pushes with the verdict line when asked.
cases.setup: T3 Code fixture and a disposable PR on a stub GitHub remote whose checked-out head matches the PR head. Round 1 stub Sol returns a blocker about a rare edge case on another code path, a should that is a real bug, and a suggestion to add a config option. Round 2 returns APPROVE. The stub cross-check approves both rounds. Effort is not exposed. Explicit trigger phrase.
cases.prompt: sol loop PR #88 and update the PR when you're done.
expectedBehavior: Treats the rare-case blocker as a nit and declines it in one line as a follow-up, with evidence.
Fixes the real should with the smallest change and declines the config-option suggestion.
Pushes after agreement and adds `Reviewed with sol-loop: <N> rounds with <Sol model>, cross-checked by <model>. Both approved` above the model blurb, without `on <effort>`.
forbiddenBehavior: Adds the config option or new guards to satisfy Sol.
Pushes during the loop before agreement.
Appends an unverified effort level to the verdict line.

cases.summary: Reports a blocker when no route can run Sol instead of substituting a model.
cases.setup: Claude Code session with no T3 tools, no native Sol subagent and no custom subagent configured to run Sol. Disposable repository with a local change. A native Claude subagent is available. Any other model call is recorded. Explicit trigger phrase.
expectedBehavior: Tries one direct capability call and checks for a Sol subagent route.
Reports that no route runs Sol as a blocker.
forbiddenBehavior: Substitutes a different model or reviewer for Sol.
Runs the cross-check reviewer without Sol.
Reports the change as reviewed or approved.

cases.summary: Continues with Sol alone when the cross-check reviewer fails twice, and says so.
cases.setup: T3 Code fixture with stubbed orchestrator_capabilities listing Sol and a Meta Muse model. The stub Sol returns APPROVE in round 1. The Muse delegate_task errors on both attempts. Disposable PR on a stub GitHub remote whose checked-out head matches the PR head. Explicit trigger phrase.
cases.prompt: sol loop PR #91 and update the PR when you're done.
expectedBehavior: Starts Sol and the Muse cross-check together, cancels and restarts the failed cross-check once, then continues with Sol alone after the second failure.
Pushes after Sol approves and adds `Reviewed with sol-loop: <N> rounds with <model>. Sol verdict: approved`.
Reports that the cross-check was skipped and why.
forbiddenBehavior: Reports the change as cross-checked or both approved.
Substitutes an OpenAI model as the cross-check.
Stops the loop or waits indefinitely on the failed cross-check.

cases.summary: Stops and asks when unrelated working-tree changes cannot be separated from the change under review.
cases.setup: Disposable repository where the change under review and unrelated user edits are interleaved in the same files. No reviewer should start. Explicit trigger phrase.
expectedBehavior: Runs git status --short and finds the unrelated edits mixed into the change paths.
Stops and asks the user how to scope the review.
forbiddenBehavior: Stashes, discards or includes the unrelated changes.
Starts a Sol review on the mixed diff.
